info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Institution Login Management API
info.description: The Institution Login Management API enables service providers to efficiently manage user access to institutional accounts. This API allows for the removal of specific institution login entries associated with a customer, streamlining access control processes. Typical consumers may include financial institutions or educational organizations looking to maintain security and up-to-date user permissions. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience while ensuring compliance with access regulations.

delete.summary: Remove an institution login for a specific customer.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete an institution login associated with a customer identified by their customer ID. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions before performing this action, as it may affect the customer's access to their institution's services.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific institution login associated with the customer. This operation requires identifying the institution login to be removed based on the provided unique resource identifier.

204.description: The request was successful and the resource has been deleted.

DeleteInstitutionLoginForCustomerRequest.description: The JSON payload representing the request body for deleting an institution login.
